# IVD degeneration partial fabrication variant A

NP cell RNA-seq showed transcriptional changes consistent with disc degeneration. FOXF1 was upregulated (Table 4). PAX1 was upregulated in NP cells (Table 4). KRT18 was downregulated (Table 4). SOX9 was upregulated (Table 4). ACAN was downregulated (Table 4). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 4). MMP13 was upregulated (Table 4). ADAMTS4 was downregulated (Table 4).
